summary: Frontend-only verification of the rebuilt Dynopay public homepage ('/') per the v7 'Mercury-style' spec. Tested signed-out at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, in light and dark themes, via the public preview URL. All 10 required sections render in correct order with the required data-testids, hero/pricing/security/three-ways/proof/faq/final-cta content is correct, FAQ expand/collapse + FAQPage JSON-LD work, hero and final CTAs navigate to the correct /auth/register?ref=... URLs, mobile menu drawer opens, there is NO horizontal overflow at either breakpoint, no console/pageerrors in either theme, and ?view=landing override works. Two minor header-anchor deviations from the spec were found (Pricing nav link + missing #products/#faq mega-menu anchors).

ui_bugs.issue: Header 'Pricing' link has href='/fees' and navigates away to the Fees page instead of smooth-scrolling to the on-page #pricing section as required by the spec ('Pricing nav link scrolls to #pricing').

Spec expects mega-menu/anchor links for #how-it-works, #products and #faq to work on the homepage. Only /#how-it-works is present and functional. No in-DOM anchor links to #products or #faq were found anywhere on the homepage header or footer.

verified_behaviours: All 10 sections present in order: hero, coins-strip, trust-bar, how-it-works, pricing, security, three-ways, proof, faq, final-cta
hero-headline reads 'Accept crypto payments. Get paid your way.'
security pillars present: security-noncustodial, security-compliance, security-keys, security-uptime; security-status-link -> /system-status; security-wallet-link -> /wallet-security
proof section contains 'The Dev Store' and 'SafeDeal'
FAQ items faq-cost / faq-speed / faq-custody / faq-coins present; clicking faq-cost toggles aria-expanded true<->false and reveals the answer body
FAQPage application/ld+json script present in DOM
Mega-menu link '/#how-it-works' smooth-scrolls the how-it-works section into view without a full page navigation
theme-toggle-button in header flips light<->dark; homepage renders cleanly in dark mode with no overflow or layout break
Mobile 390: mobile-menu-toggle opens the drawer with mnav-* items; no horizontal overflow
?view=landing on '/' renders the marketing homepage (hero data-testid present)
No console errors or pageerror events recorded in either theme
action_items: Make the header 'Pricing' link smooth-scroll to #pricing on the homepage (and only fall back to /fees on non-home pages), as required by the spec.
Add mega-menu / header anchor entries that link to /#products (or the equivalent three-ways section id) and /#faq so the full set of hash anchors from the spec is navigable.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero and Final primary CTAs are <button> elements that imperatively navigate on click; they expose no href. This works functionally but hurts SEO/right-click/open-in-new-tab UX. Consider using <Link> / <a href='/auth/register?ref=hero'> with an onClick for tracking.

data-theme attribute on <html> is not toggled when switching themes (classList stays empty too). Visually dark mode works, but automated/CSS consumers that key off [data-theme='dark'] or .dark will miss it. Confirm Tailwind dark variant and consumer code are driven off whatever attribute is actually used.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (18/20 spec items pass; 2 minor header-anchor deviations)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://secure-vault-app-58.preview.emergentagent.com. Test signed-out (clear localStorage 'token'). Use ?view=landing to force the marketing homepage. Hero/Final primary CTAs are buttons (no href) that programmatically navigate to /auth/register?ref=hero|final. Theme toggle is data-testid 'theme-toggle-button' in the header; visually flips but does not set a data-theme attribute on <html>. Horizontal overflow must be measured on document.documentElement, not on individual marquee elements.
